reference_da.titre: Apple Woods / Bois aux Pommes (Pokemon Donjon Mystere : Explorateurs du Ciel, Apple_Woods_entrance_TDS.png)

generation.prompt: WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3 (1200x896), zoomed out, top-down 3/4 Nintendo DS Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky pixel art environment map of the deep Apple Woods sanctuary clearing (closed northern cul-de-sac), strictly matching the exact colors, pixel art textures, and palette of the reference image Apple_Woods_entrance_TDS.png. A warm sandy-ochre dirt path (#F1BC74) enters at the bottom center (south) between green trees and opens into a large circular sandy-ochre clearing in the center, bordered by wavy light yellow-green grass (#78BB47), small pink-purple flower bushes, and 6 tan boulders (#C89858). The entire top (north), left, and right sides are completely closed by a dense semicircle of lush emerald-green orchard trees (#426F2C) heavily laden with bright red apples (#C53E1F) — NO northern exit path, NO dark cave hole. At the north-center edge of the clearing, nestled directly in front of the closed northern wall of apple-laden trees, stands one grand ancient giant Apple Tree with thick gnarled roots, a mossy stone pedestal at its base, and clusters of golden and bright red Perfect Apples in its crown. Crisp DS pixel art, no characters, no UI, no text.
generation.essais: premier essai ; conforme (chemin 8.3, herbe_claire 4.5, herbe_feuillage 7.9, pommes 11.1)

generation.prompt: Exact same 1200x896 top-down Nintendo DS Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Apple Woods sanctuary clearing map as the first reference image, keeping the exact same sandy-ochre dirt path and circular central clearing (#F1BC74), wavy light yellow-green grass border (#78BB47), and deep emerald-green meadow grass (#426F2C) in the exact same pixel positions, with the northern edge completely covered in emerald-green meadow grass (#426F2C), and with ALL trees, the giant central apple tree, stone pedestal, boulders, bushes, and flowers completely removed and replaced seamlessly by the underlying emerald-green meadow grass (#426F2C) and sandy-ochre clearing (#F1BC74). Flat clean ground-only witness image, no trees, no pedestal, no boulders, no flowers.

2D Nintendo DS Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky pixel-art sprite sheet on a solid, uniform, flat pure magenta #FF00FF background (RGB 255, 0, 255) with NO anti-aliasing against the magenta background and NO magenta inside the sprites. Contains 18 well-separated orchard animation sprites inspired by Apple_Woods_entrance_TDS.png arranged in 3 clean rows with generous #FF00FF spacing: Row 1 (6 poses): bright red PMD apples (#D83820, #F86040, highlight #F8C8A8, green leaf #68C840, dark brown stem #583820) — upright whole apple, tilted falling apple left, tilted falling apple right, slightly squashed landing apple, apple with small dust puff, and golden Perfect Apple (#F8C838, #D89818). Row 2 (6 poses): fluttering emerald and lime orchard leaves (#488830, #78C048, #A8E068) — horizontal leaf, tilted 45 deg left, vertical spinning leaf, tilted 45 deg right, curled leaf, and twin small leaves. Row 3 (6 poses): small pink-white blossom petals and golden pollen sparkles (#F8B8D8, #F8E898) from tiny dot to 4-point star sparkle. Crisp 1-pixel stepped edges, no text, no grid lines.
